title: Automations with a fixed time don't always start reliably
symptom: Automations with a fixed time (e.g., at 20:00) sometimes do not start reliably. The user observes that the background automation queries occur at irregular intervals, sometimes with gaps of several minutes, and when a fixed-time automation falls within such a gap, it is missed. This happens about once a week for one of three fixed-time automations.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user speculates that the irregular query intervals cause fixed-time automations to be missed, but no maintainer confirms this as the cause.
evidence_quote: The 8:00 PM query exceeded a tolerance, and the start was discarded. I have automations with three fixed times. About once a week, one of them is discarded.
